verdict.rationale: Terraform's official MCP server gives AI models real-time access to provider docs, modules, and policies, and HashiCorp says it enables more accurate Terraform configuration generation. That is an indirect way for an external AI assistant to help author configuration from natural language. The rest of the evidence shows Terraform itself is driven by HCL files and CLI commands (plan/apply/show), not natural-language input. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface, documented ability for the MCP server to run or operate Terraform (plan/apply/state), and hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven workflows.
